## Windows setup without packed data
- **No more "packed" setup:** the Windows setup (`Streyn.exe`) now carries the app and the offline server exactly as they are installed, no longer compressed. Compressed program files inside a program look like a hidden payload to virus scanners ("software packing" / "obfuscated" on VirusTotal), even though they were only zipped. Both files are still checked against their checksum before anything is written
- The download is larger because of this (about 17 MB instead of 7 MB)

## Install
- **Windows:** download `Streyn.exe` once and run it, or use Update in the app
- **Server / Android / Linux:** nothing changes
